about: UI state inventory for the coverage crawler (qa/ui-crawl). Every interactive control in the templates and browser scripts must be named in a state's `covers` list or in `ignored_controls`; qa/ui-coverage.spec.js fails otherwise. `covers` means the state renders the control (and actuates it when the steps say so). See CONTRIBUTING.md, UI coverage.

safety_classes.read: Looks only. The crawler's network guard admits only exact routes the reviewed manifest (qa/ui-routes.json) classes as read or read-post that the page's own scripts can send on the target's scope kind (generated: qa/ui-read-reach.json), bound to the target's system, enclosure and storage view; any other route, any unknown route and any forced appliance refresh is aborted and fails the run.
safety_classes.app-write-revert: Changes app-local state only (names, notes, display preferences, saved views/page order). The crawler records the original value and reads the store through the app's read API (`semantic_reads`), performs the write, performs the exact `revert` steps immediately, then reloads and re-reads to verify the original is back and the store reads back equal. Only the requests in `writes` are admitted, only while the state runs, and only for the write system, the target enclosure and the captured bay.
safety_classes.led: Turns a bay's identify (locate) light on and then off, and verifies it reads back off. Only POST .../led with IDENTIFY then CLEAR for the selected bay is admitted.
safety_classes.forbidden: Would change an appliance or array beyond the identify LED, an account or sudo, start a SMART test, back up or restore, purge or adopt history, or save configuration that reaches appliances. Listed for completeness and never actuated. With `confirm_preview` the crawler may press the control only to render a harmless native confirmation, which it always dismisses; the guard aborts the request in any case.

main.description: Enclosure page: chassis face, bay details, heat map, history drawer, connections panel, mapping, export.

load_requests.why: QuantaStor pages with LED-capable bays queue one forced inventory read at startup to re-check locate lights (app.js queueIdentifyVerify("startup")). It is the page load's own request, so every state on a QuantaStor target inherits it: admitted only in the window of that page load, once per load, bound to the target's system and enclosure (Sol #1108).

The same startup refresh then reloads the storage-view runtime with force (refreshSnapshot -> fetchStorageViewRuntime(force)) once the inventory answers; same window, once per load, bound to the target.

selection.why: Controls whose press selects a bay (a selectBay step, or pressing one of `controls`, whose handlers call selectSlot()); derived per state in qa/ui-crawl/inventory.js selectsBay(). The bay detail then asks for that bay's SMART summary directly (renderLiveSlotDetail -> ensureSmartSummary), even before the batch prefetch. That read is no longer declared here: it is generated from app.js for the main page (qa/ui-read-reach.json, D-TNJ-20261109-CRAWLER-SWEEP) and bound to the target's system and enclosure. The browser test crawls every selecting state on a page whose prefetch has not started.

fabric.description: Storage Fabric page: Storage Lanes, Impact Map, Physical Trace and Disk Path tabs with the inspector.

states.description: Relative colours stretch from the coolest to the warmest bay by design, so heat-map findings are reported as warnings here.

Timeline playback exists only for metrics with history samples (app.js heatmapMetricSupportsTimeline), so the state picks temperature first; on a storage-view scope it reads the view's history (Codex #1108).
A storage-view slot has no bay assignment form, so on a storage-view scope (a system whose first scope is a view) this state is not applicable.

states.follow_up_why: Refresh sends a forced inventory read, and the forced storage-view read only once that answers (refreshSnapshot); on a slow appliance the inventory answer can come after the steps' fixed wait (#1128). For 30 s after the steps end, and only until the next navigation, the declared forced reads with budget left stay admitted; nothing else, and a follow-up later than that is a hard failure.
